why: No stated as-built hub height or rotor; the only figures are an implied sweep range that conflicts between the two versions of the report, and the wind-resource section's 100 m hub from the 2018 micrositing report (design).

note_zh: 《華電陽江青洲三海上風電場項目海域使用補充論證報告書》（公示稿，國家海洋局南海調查技術中心 2022-12 編製，陽江市自然資源局 2023-01 公示）：因「批建不一致」須對實際施工的用海單元重新論證（2023-03 青洲四報告書寫近海深水區僅青洲三已建設完成）；中標並建成的機型為明陽 MySE6.8-158 37 台（預裝輪轂高度 110 m、風輪直徑 158 m）與 MySE8.3-180 30 台（預裝輪轂高度 115 m、風輪直徑 178 m），輪轂寫範圍、葉輪取最大機型 178 m；場址水深 41–46 m。注意：數值在機型選擇段落，同段留有「預計明年交貨」等招標階段文字，用語與沙扒四期已採用的「預裝輪轂高度」相同。
note_en: Huadian Yangjiang Qingzhou 3 supplementary sea-use report (public version, prepared Dec 2022 by the SOA South China Sea survey centre, published by the Yangjiang natural resources bureau Jan 2023): written to re-demonstrate the actually built sea-use units after an 'approved vs built' mismatch (the Mar 2023 Qingzhou 4 report says Qingzhou 3 is the only completed farm in the deep-water zone); the tendered and installed models are 37 Mingyang MySE6.8-158 (pre-set hub height 110 m, rotor 158 m) and 30 MySE8.3-180 (pre-set hub height 115 m, rotor 178 m), so hub 110–115 m and rotor 178 m (largest model); site depth 41–46 m. Caveat: the figures sit in the model-selection paragraph, which still carries tender-stage wording ('type certificate expected before next year's first delivery'); the term is the same 'pre-set hub height' accepted for Shapa phase 4.
why: Depth 41–46 m and rotor 178 m were written into farm_dimensions.py (v2.30.3). The hub heights 110 / 115 m ("预装轮毂高度") sit in the tender-stage model-selection paragraph, so they are kept as a lead until an as-built source (completion acceptance) confirms them.
